name: Punk Rocker 2

features.name: Riot Respins
features.description: Bonus symbols become locked Molotov Wilds.

features.name: Three bonus modes
features.description: Different jumping wild counts and train enhancers.

review:
A 6x3 sequel where two bonus symbols trigger Riot Respins – they turn into Molotov Wilds and lock their reels. The bonus comes in three flavours: DisOBEY, ChAos and Mass Transit BBQ Spins, each with different numbers of jumping wilds and train enhancers.

xWays adds symbol stacks on top. Loud, angry and swingy, just like the theme. Extreme volatility, 30,144x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
